title: Yaya Higgsfield Genjutsu Ke Aiki? Mataki-mataki, da Hanya Mai Rahusa | DeHub
description: An bayyana Genjutsu mataki-mataki: zurfi, abin rufe fuska, ragar fuska, gyaran hoto da sautin asali, tare da hotunan gaske daga kowane mataki. Da canjin fage irin na Katana da hanya mai rahusa ta kowane bidiyo.
h1: Yaya Higgsfield Genjutsu Ke Aiki? Da Yadda Maboroshi Ke Yin Aiki Ɗaya da Rahusa (2026)
body:
Higgsfield Genjutsu yana ɗaukar bidiyo na gaske ya musanya abu ɗaya a cikinsa: mutum, dabbar gida, kaya, ko sutura. Motsin kyamara, lokaci da bango suna nan daidai yadda aka ɗauka. Higgsfield ba ya faɗin yadda yake aiki, don haka yawancin mutane suna tsammanin samfuri ɗaya ne na sirri.

Ba haka ba ne. Idan aka warware shi, gyaran bidiyo irin na Genjutsu jerin matakai takwas ne, kuma kusan kowane mahaɗi samfuri ne na buɗaɗɗe da aka sani. Mun sake gina wannan jerin a matsayin Maboroshi, cikin DeHub Creator. Gudanar da shi da kanmu ya nuna mana inda kuɗin ke tafiya da gaske, kuma shi ya sa za mu iya karɓar ƙasa da haka.

Wannan jagorar tana bin kowane mataki tare da hoton gaske daga kowanne. Sannan ta yi bayanin canza fage gaba ɗaya, nawa kowane zaɓi ke kashewa, da abin da ke faruwa da bidiyonka bayan an yi shi.

Abin da Higgsfield Genjutsu ke yi

A cewar shafin Genjutsu na Higgsfield, akwai yanayi biyu:

  • Motion Transfer. Motsin bidiyonka yana tafiyar da sabon hali ko fagen da aka sake ginawa.
  • Object Swap. Abu ɗaya da ka ambata ana musanya shi yayin da sauran hoton suka tsaya a wurinsu. Misalan Higgsfield sune kaya, kayan aiki da sutura.

Kana loda bidiyo ɗaya na daƙiƙa 4 zuwa 30, ka ƙara hotunan misali har 30, sannan ka zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin saitattu 30+ ko ka rubuta gajeren bayani. Sakamakon yana kaiwa 1080p. Higgsfield ba ya faɗin samfuran da ke aiki a ƙasa.

Abin da kake gani shine sakamakon. Motsin kyamara yana nan, haske ya dace, sabon abin yana tsaye a bayan abubuwan da suka dace, kuma baki yana motsi daidai da murya. Samfurin text-to-video shi kaɗai ba zai iya yin haka ba, don haka dole wani abu ya fara auna bidiyon asali. Wannan auna shine abin da mutane ke kira injiniyanci na baya, kuma ya rabu zuwa ayyuka takwas.

Yadda yake aiki, mataki-mataki

Mafarinmu shine Genjutsu Open Source Workflow na Sirio Berati mai lasisin MIT. Ya nuna cewa za a iya sake gina tasirin daga sassa na buɗaɗɗe. Mun riƙe matakan da ke da muhimmanci, mun maye gurbin waɗanda ba su da aminci ga masu amfani na gaske, kuma mun ƙara biyan kuɗi, dubawa da farfaɗowa. Kowane hoto a ƙasa an yi shi ta hanyar gudanar da matakin akan bidiyo na gaske.

Mataki na 1: Daidaita bidiyon

Kowane loda ana mayar da shi zuwa firam 24 a kowace daƙiƙa a tsaye, kuma ana rage shi zuwa pixel 960 a mafi yawa a gefensa mai tsawo. Bidiyon waya sau da yawa yana da adadin firam mai canzawa, wanda ke sa samfurin ya rasa daidaito. Tsayayyen adadi da tsayayyen girma suna ba kowane mataki na gaba layi ɗaya da zai yi aiki a kai, kuma suna sa sarrafawa ya yi sauri da rahusa.

Bidiyon dole ya kasance daƙiƙa 30 ko ƙasa da haka kuma dole ya kasance da sauti. A hanyar Kling ta Maboroshi dole ya kasance daƙiƙa 3 zuwa 15, tare da aƙalla pixel 720 a kowane gefe.

Mataki na 2: Cire sautin

Ana cire sauti kafin a fara ƙirƙirar komai. Demucs, samfuri na buɗaɗɗe, yana raba murya da kiɗa, don haka samfurin bidiyo yana samun abin da yake buƙata kawai. Ana ajiye cikakken sautin asali a gefe, ba a taɓa shi ba.

Shi ya sa bidiyon da aka gama yake jin daidai kamar na asali. Samfuran bidiyo ba su iya sarrafa sauti da kyau: suna canza lokacinsa, suna ɓata shi ko suna ƙirƙirar sababbin sautuka. Don haka sautin asali ba ya taɓa wucewa ta samfurin kwata-kwata.

Mataki na 3: Taswirar zurfi

Samfurin zurfi yana ƙiyasta nisan kowane pixel daga kyamara, firam bayan firam. Maboroshi yana amfani da Video Depth Anything, wanda aka gina don bidiyo kuma yana tsayawa daidai daga firam ɗaya zuwa na gaba. An yi hoton da ke ƙasa da ƙaramin samfurin zurfi na firam ɗaya, amma ra'ayin iri ɗaya ne: na kusa yana haske, na nesa yana duhu.

Zurfi shine abin da ke bar sabon abin ya tsaya a wuri ɗaya, a girman da ya dace, a gaban tasi kuma a bayan sandar fitila. Ba tare da shi ba, halayen da aka musanya suna yawo a sama.

Mataki na 4: Yanke abin

SAM 3 Video, Segment Anything na Meta don bidiyo, yana nemo abin da ka ambata (misali "person") kuma yana zana tsaftataccen abin rufe fuska a kewaye da shi a kowane firam. Ƙananan guntuwa a gefuna ana tsaftace su kai tsaye don kada pixel masu ɓata su rikita samfurin. Abin rufe fuskar yana gaya wa mai gyara hoto daidai abin da zai musanya da abin da zai bari.

Mataki na 5: Bin diddigin fuska

MediaPipe Face Landmarker yana zana raga mai maki 478 akan kowace fuska, a kowane firam. Wannan raga tana ɗauke da yanayin fuska, juyawar kai da motsin leɓe zuwa sabon hali. Shi ya sa mage da aka musanya zai iya kama da yana rera layin waƙar.

Mataki na 6: Kana duba bidiyon sarrafawa

Zurfi, abin rufe fuska da ragar fuska ana haɗa su zuwa bidiyon sarrafawa ɗaya, kuma kana ganinsa kafin wani abu mai tsada ya faru. Idan yankan ba daidai ba ne, ka tsaya a nan kuma ba za ka biya komai ba. Gyaran ƙarshe yana gudana ne kawai akan ainihin sigar da ka amince da ita. Ka canza bidiyon, abin ko misalin kuma amincewar za ta sake farawa.

Higgsfield ba ya nuna maka wannan matakin. Muna ganin shine mafi amfani, saboda mummunan abin rufe fuska shine babban dalilin da gyaran da aka biya yake dawowa ba daidai ba.

Mataki na 7: Gyaran hoto

Gyaran yana gudana ta ɗaya daga cikin hanyoyi biyu:

  • Hanyar Seedance Premium. Seedance 2.5 reference-to-video yana yin daftari mai arha daga bidiyon sarrafawa da hotunan misalinka. Kana biyan 1080p ne kawai idan daftarin ya burge ka, kuma ana kammala na ƙarshe daga wannan daftarin, don haka abin da ka amince da shi shine abin da za ka samu.
  • Hanyar Kling. Bidiyon asali da hoto ɗaya ko biyu na hali suna zuwa Kling O3 video-to-video edit a lokaci ɗaya. Babu shiri kuma babu daftari. Ya fi sauri da rahusa, kuma shine zaɓinmu na asali ga yawancin musanya.

Mataki na 8: Mayar da sautin asali

Hanyoyin biyu suna ƙarewa ta hanyar mayar da cikakken sautin asali, ana kwafa shi ba a sake ɓoye shi ba. Murya, bugun kiɗa da lokaci suna daidai yadda ka ɗauka, kuma wannan shine abu na farko da mutane ke lura da shi idan suka kwatanta sakamako gefe da gefe.

Canza kowane fage, ko kowane abu a cikinsa

A ranar 12 ga Oktoba, 2026, Higgsfield ya ƙaddamar da Katana, fasahar gyara da ke aiki cikin hira ta AI. Kana ba shi bidiyon misali, ko saiti daga ɗakin karatunsa, tare da hotuna har biyar na mutane, kaya ko tufafi. Yana sake gina dukan gyaran a kewaye da su, yana riƙe tsarin hotuna da saurin misalin, kuma yana sake yin hotunan da ka gyara kawai. Yana buƙatar shirin Higgsfield mai aiki kuma yana kashe kiredit na wannan shirin.

DeHub yana yin aiki ɗaya da kayan aiki uku, duka ana farashinsu a kowane bidiyo:

  • Remake, don gyare-gyare masu hotuna da yawa. Loda bidiyo mai yanke-yanke. Maboroshi yana nemo wuraren yanka da kansa, ko kai ka yi musu alama (har bakwai), kuma yana raba bidiyon zuwa hotuna har takwas. Kowane hoto yana samun nasa umarni, kuma za ka iya sake yin kowane hoto ɗaya har sau biyar ba tare da taɓa sauran ba. Idan ka gamsu, ana haɗa hotunan a jere tare da sautin asali, kuma haɗawar ba ta ƙara kuɗi. Kowane hoto ana farashinsa kamar musanyar Kling ta yau da kullum.
  • Kling O3 Character Swap, don kowane abu a cikin firam. A cikin DeHub Creator, wannan samfurin yana musanya halaye, kaya ko shimfiɗar wuri cikin bidiyonka daga hotuna har huɗu. Yi amfani da shi don canza mota, abin sha a hannun wani, jaket, ko titin da ke bayansu.
  • Seedance 2.0 restyle, don fage gaba ɗaya. Har ila yau a Creator, loda bidiyo ka bayyana sabon kamanni, kamar dare, wasan kwaikwayo na yumɓu ko guguwar dusar ƙanƙara. Motsin yana nan kuma duk duniyar da ke kewaye tana canzawa.

Hoton da ke ƙasa yana nuna yadda Remake ke gano yanke-yanke akan bidiyon tallanmu. Ya gano yanke uku kai tsaye kuma ya raba bidiyon zuwa hotuna huɗu.

Dalilin da ya sa za mu iya yi da rahusa

Kowane mataki a sama banda gyaran hoto yana da arha a gudanar. Daidaitawa, raba sauti, zurfi, abin rufe fuska da ragar fuska suna aiki akan sabar mu kuma suna kashe 'yan centi. Kuɗin yana cikin samfurin gyaran ƙarshe, wanda ake caji a kowace daƙiƙa. Don haka mu:

  • Muna caji a kowace daƙiƙa. Bidiyo na daƙiƙa 5 ba a cajinsa kamar na daƙiƙa 15.
  • Muna tsallake matakin biya idan ba a buƙata. Hanyar Kling ba ta da kuɗin shiri kuma babu kuɗin HD na daban.
  • Muna sa ka fara dubawa. Kana amince da abin rufe fuska kafin ka biya, don haka gyare-gyaren da aka biya kaɗan ne ke lalacewa.
  • Babu biyan kuɗin wata-wata. Kana biyan bidiyon da ke gabanka, kuma kiredit da ka cika a DeHub ba ya ƙarewa.

Bidiyo na daƙiƙa 15, gefe da gefe:

  • Higgsfield Genjutsu, 1080p: kiredit 144, kusan $7.20, ana buƙatar shiri
  • Higgsfield Genjutsu, 720p: kiredit 104, kusan $5.20, ana buƙatar shiri
  • DeHub Maboroshi, hanyar Kling, tare da duba abin rufe fuska da sautin asali: $4.55
  • DeHub Creator, Kling O3 Character Swap a 1080p: $3.02
  • Higgsfield Genjutsu, 480p: kiredit 40, kusan $2.00, ana buƙatar shiri

Gajerun bidiyoyi, inda caji a kowace daƙiƙa ke cin nasara:

  • Daƙiƙa 5: Maboroshi $1.75, musanyar Creator $1.01
  • Daƙiƙa 10: Maboroshi $3.15, musanyar Creator $2.02
  • Daƙiƙa 15: Maboroshi $4.55, musanyar Creator $3.02

Gargaɗi biyu na gaskiya. Idan bidiyo na 480p kawai kake buƙata kuma kana biyan shirin Higgsfield tuni, $2.00 nasa ya fi arha. Kuma hanyarmu ta Seedance Premium a cikakken 1080p tana da tsada fiye da Higgsfield sosai, kusan $31 na daƙiƙa 15, saboda tana cajin kowace daƙiƙa ta shigarwa da fitarwa kusa da abin da samfurin ke kashe mana. Mun yi bayani dalla-dalla a jagorarmu ta madadin Higgsfield Genjutsu.

Gyara shi, wallafa shi, sami kuɗi da shi

Higgsfield yana tsayawa a maɓallin saukewa. A DeHub, bidiyon mafari ne, ba ƙarshen aikin ba.

Editan bidiyo na ciki. Editan bidiyo na DeHub yana aiki a burauzarka da cikin manhajar DeHub. Layin lokaci ne na gaske mai waƙoƙi da yawa, ba kawai sandar yankewa ba. Saka bidiyon Maboroshi kusa da sauran bidiyoyinka, sannan:

  • Yanke a canjin fage da bugun kiɗa.
  • Ƙara rubutun ƙasa, kuma fassara dukan waƙar rubutun ƙasa zuwa wani harshe.
  • Cire bango.
  • Ƙirƙiri kiɗan baya ko tasirin sauti.
  • Ɗauki allonka ko muryarka kai tsaye zuwa layin lokaci.

Ayyuka suna adanuwa a gajimare tare da tarihin sigogi, kuma za ka iya raba gyara don samun sharhin dubawa masu alamar lokaci.

Manhajar sada zumunta da ke kewaye da shi. DeHub hanyar sadarwar zamantakewa ce da kuma ɗakin aiki, don haka gyaran da aka gama yana tafiya kai tsaye daga editan zuwa rubutu ko Short. A can, masu kallo za su iya ba ka kyauta, kuma kallonka ana ƙidaya su don ladan watch-to-earn. Masu kallo masu wasu harsuna za su iya kunna fassarar murya ta atomatik. DeHub yana ci gaba da ƙara abubuwa ga feed, Shorts, watsa shirye-shirye kai tsaye da wakilan AI da za su iya wallafawa bisa jadawali.

Asusu ɗaya yana rufe dukan zagayen: yi musanyar, yanke ta zuwa gyara, wallafa ta kuma a biya ka.

Gwada shi

  1. Buɗe dehub.io/creator/maboroshi don musanya abu, ko zaɓi Kling O3 Character Swap a DeHub Creator don canza kowane abu a cikin firam.
  2. Loda gajeren bidiyo mai sauti da hoton misali ɗaya ko biyu masu haske.
  3. Duba abin rufe fuska, amince, sannan ka yi gyaran. Ana nuna farashin a dala kafin ka biya.
  4. Buɗe sakamakon a editan bidiyo, kammala gyaranka, kuma wallafa shi a feed ɗinka.

Tambayoyin da ake yawan yi

Yaya Higgsfield Genjutsu ke aiki?

Higgsfield ba ya wallafa tsarin aikinsa. Ana gina tasiri irin wannan ta hanyar fara auna bidiyon asali: adadin firam, sauti, zurfi, siffar abin da ragar fuska. Sannan samfurin reference-to-video ko video-edit yana sake yin abin kawai, kuma ana mayar da sautin asali a ƙarshe. Maboroshi yana gudanar da ainihin wannan jerin, kuma wannan jagorar tana nuna kowane mataki.

Waɗanne samfura ne gyaran irin na Genjutsu ke amfani da su?

A Maboroshi: Demucs don sauti, Video Depth Anything don zurfi, SAM 3 Video don abin rufe fuska, MediaPipe Face Landmarker don fuska, da Seedance 2.5 reference-to-video ko Kling O3 video-to-video edit don gyaran hoto.

Shin Maboroshi ya fi Higgsfield Genjutsu arha?

A 720p da 1080p, eh. Bidiyo na daƙiƙa 15 yana kashe $4.55 a hanyar Kling ta Maboroshi da $3.02 da Kling O3 Character Swap na Creator, idan aka kwatanta da kusan $5.20 da $7.20 a Higgsfield. Babu zaɓin DeHub da ke buƙatar biyan kuɗin wata-wata. Zaɓin 480p na Higgsfield, kusan $2.00, ya fi arha idan kana da shiri tuni.

Menene Higgsfield Katana, kuma DeHub yana da wani abu makamancinsa?

Katana fasaha ce ta Higgsfield ta hira don sake gina gyaran misali da mutanenka, kayanka ko tufafinka. A DeHub, Remake yana sake gina bidiyoyi masu hotuna da yawa hoto bayan hoto, Kling O3 Character Swap yana canza halaye, kaya ko shimfiɗar wuri, kuma Seedance 2.0 yana canza salon fage gaba ɗaya. Duka ukun ana farashinsu a kowane bidiyo.

Zan iya canza bango ko abubuwa, ba mutum kawai ba?

Eh. Yi amfani da Kling O3 Character Swap a DeHub Creator don musanya kaya ko shimfiɗar wuri daga hotunan misali, ko Seedance 2.0 don canza salon dukan bidiyon da umarni. Maboroshi da kansa yana riƙe bango daidai yadda aka ɗauka, wanda shine abin da kake so don tsaftataccen musanyar abu.

Sautin asali yana nan?

Eh. A hanyoyin Maboroshi biyu, ana kwafa cikakken sautin asali zuwa bidiyon da aka gama, ba a taɓa shi ba.

Ƙananan bayanai

Alƙaluman Genjutsu na Higgsfield sun fito daga shafin Genjutsu nasa kamar yadda aka duba a Satumba 2026. Bayanan Katana sun fito daga labarin Katana na Higgsfield na 12 ga Oktoba, 2026. Higgsfield yana farashi da kiredit kuma yana canza shirinsa sau da yawa, don haka duba farashinsa na yanzu kafin ka kwatanta. Farashin DeHub farashin dillali ne a lokacin rubutu, kuma farashin da ake nunawa kafin kowane mataki shine koyaushe farashin da za ka biya. An yi hoton zurfi a mataki na 3 da samfurin zurfi na firam ɗaya don misali. Maboroshi da kansa yana amfani da Video Depth Anything.

**MediaPipe Face Landmarker** yana zana raga mai maki 478 akan kowace fuska, a kowane firam. Wannan raga tana ɗauke da yanayin fuska, juyawar kai da motsin leɓe zuwa sabon hali. Shi ya sa mage da aka musanya zai iya kama da yana rera layin waƙar.

![Hoton kai a dandalin jirgin ƙasa tare da ragar fuska mai maki 478 da aka zana akan fuskar mutumin](/media/maboroshi/how/step-face.jpg)

### Mataki na 6: Kana duba bidiyon sarrafawa

Zurfi, abin rufe fuska da ragar fuska ana haɗa su zuwa **bidiyon sarrafawa** ɗaya, kuma kana ganinsa kafin wani abu mai tsada ya faru. Idan yankan ba daidai ba ne, ka tsaya a nan kuma ba za ka biya komai ba. Gyaran ƙarshe yana gudana ne kawai akan ainihin sigar da ka amince da ita. Ka canza bidiyon, abin ko misalin kuma amincewar za ta sake farawa.

Higgsfield ba ya nuna maka wannan matakin. Muna ganin shine mafi amfani, saboda mummunan abin rufe fuska shine babban dalilin da gyaran da aka biya yake dawowa ba daidai ba.

![Firam na asali kusa da haɗaɗɗen bidiyon sarrafawa: zurfi da launin toka da abin rufe fuska da fari, tare da maɓallin Amince](/media/maboroshi/how/step-review.jpg)

### Mataki na 7: Gyaran hoto

Gyaran yana gudana ta ɗaya daga cikin hanyoyi biyu:

- **Hanyar Seedance Premium.** **Seedance 2.5 reference-to-video** yana yin daftari mai arha daga bidiyon sarrafawa da hotunan misalinka. Kana biyan 1080p ne kawai idan daftarin ya burge ka, kuma ana kammala na ƙarshe daga wannan daftarin, don haka abin da ka amince da shi shine abin da za ka samu.
- **Hanyar Kling.** Bidiyon asali da hoto ɗaya ko biyu na hali suna zuwa **Kling O3 video-to-video edit** a lokaci ɗaya. Babu shiri kuma babu daftari. Ya fi sauri da rahusa, kuma shine zaɓinmu na asali ga yawancin musanya.

![Kafin da bayan: mutum a mashigar titi ya zama mage mai gashi, da matakai iri ɗaya da titi iri ɗaya](/media/maboroshi/how/step-render.jpg)

![Mashigar titi iri ɗaya, kafin da bayan, a matsayin bidiyon da za a iya kunnawa|/media/maboroshi/cat-crosswalk.jpg](/media/maboroshi/cat-crosswalk.mp4)

### Mataki na 8: Mayar da sautin asali

Hanyoyin biyu suna ƙarewa ta hanyar mayar da **cikakken sautin asali**, ana kwafa shi ba a sake ɓoye shi ba. Murya, bugun kiɗa da lokaci suna daidai yadda ka ɗauka, kuma wannan shine abu na farko da mutane ke lura da shi idan suka kwatanta sakamako gefe da gefe.

## Canza kowane fage, ko kowane abu a cikinsa

A ranar 12 ga Oktoba, 2026, Higgsfield ya ƙaddamar da **[Katana](https://higgsfield.ai/blog/higgsfield-katana)**, fasahar gyara da ke aiki cikin hira ta AI. Kana ba shi bidiyon misali, ko saiti daga ɗakin karatunsa, tare da hotuna har biyar na mutane, kaya ko tufafi. Yana sake gina dukan gyaran a kewaye da su, yana riƙe tsarin hotuna da saurin misalin, kuma yana sake yin hotunan da ka gyara kawai. Yana buƙatar shirin Higgsfield mai aiki kuma yana kashe kiredit na wannan shirin.

![Kowane fage, kowane abu: sake gina gyaran misali hoto bayan hoto a DeHub](/media/maboroshi/how/fig-katana.jpg)

DeHub yana yin aiki ɗaya da kayan aiki uku, duka ana farashinsu a kowane bidiyo:

- **Remake, don gyare-gyare masu hotuna da yawa.** Loda bidiyo mai yanke-yanke. Maboroshi yana nemo wuraren yanka da kansa, ko kai ka yi musu alama (har bakwai), kuma yana raba bidiyon zuwa hotuna har takwas. Kowane hoto yana samun nasa umarni, kuma za ka iya sake yin kowane hoto ɗaya har sau biyar ba tare da taɓa sauran ba. Idan ka gamsu, ana haɗa hotunan a jere tare da sautin asali, kuma haɗawar ba ta ƙara kuɗi. Kowane hoto ana farashinsa kamar musanyar Kling ta yau da kullum.
- **Kling O3 Character Swap, don kowane abu a cikin firam.** A cikin [DeHub Creator](/creator), wannan samfurin yana musanya halaye, **kaya ko shimfiɗar wuri** cikin bidiyonka daga hotuna har huɗu. Yi amfani da shi don canza mota, abin sha a hannun wani, jaket, ko titin da ke bayansu.
- **Seedance 2.0 restyle, don fage gaba ɗaya.** Har ila yau a Creator, loda bidiyo ka bayyana sabon kamanni, kamar dare, wasan kwaikwayo na yumɓu ko guguwar dusar ƙanƙara. Motsin yana nan kuma duk duniyar da ke kewaye tana canzawa.

Hoton da ke ƙasa yana nuna yadda Remake ke gano yanke-yanke akan bidiyon tallanmu. Ya gano yanke uku kai tsaye kuma ya raba bidiyon zuwa hotuna huɗu.

![Remake yana raba tallar daƙiƙa 19 zuwa hotuna huɗu a wuraren yanka uku da aka gano kai tsaye](/media/maboroshi/how/remake-cuts.jpg)

## Dalilin da ya sa za mu iya yi da rahusa

Kowane mataki a sama banda gyaran hoto yana da arha a gudanar. Daidaitawa, raba sauti, zurfi, abin rufe fuska da ragar fuska suna aiki akan sabar mu kuma suna kashe 'yan centi. Kuɗin yana cikin samfurin gyaran ƙarshe, wanda ake caji a kowace daƙiƙa. Don haka mu:

- **Muna caji a kowace daƙiƙa.** Bidiyo na daƙiƙa 5 ba a cajinsa kamar na daƙiƙa 15.
- **Muna tsallake matakin biya idan ba a buƙata.** Hanyar Kling ba ta da kuɗin shiri kuma babu kuɗin HD na daban.
- **Muna sa ka fara dubawa.** Kana amince da abin rufe fuska kafin ka biya, don haka gyare-gyaren da aka biya kaɗan ne ke lalacewa.
- **Babu biyan kuɗin wata-wata.** Kana biyan bidiyon da ke gabanka, kuma kiredit da ka cika a DeHub [ba ya ƙarewa](/guides/dehub-creator-vs-higgsfield-ai-credits).

![Farashin musanyar daƙiƙa 15: Higgsfield $7.20 a 1080p, $5.20 a 720p da $2.00 a 480p, idan aka kwatanta da DeHub Maboroshi a $4.55 da musanyar Kling O3 ta DeHub Creator a $3.02](/media/maboroshi/how/cost-chart.jpg)

**Bidiyo na daƙiƙa 15, gefe da gefe:**

- Higgsfield Genjutsu, 1080p: kiredit 144, kusan **$7.20**, ana buƙatar shiri
- Higgsfield Genjutsu, 720p: kiredit 104, kusan **$5.20**, ana buƙatar shiri
- DeHub Maboroshi, hanyar Kling, tare da duba abin rufe fuska da sautin asali: **$4.55**

**Gajerun bidiyoyi, inda caji a kowace daƙiƙa ke cin nasara:**

- Daƙiƙa 5: Maboroshi **$1.75**, musanyar Creator **$1.01**
- Daƙiƙa 10: Maboroshi **$3.15**, musanyar Creator **$2.02**
- Daƙiƙa 15: Maboroshi **$4.55**, musanyar Creator **$3.02**

![Farashi bisa tsawo a DeHub: $1.75, $3.15 da $4.55 a Maboroshi, da $1.01, $2.02 da $3.02 a musanyar Kling O3 ta Creator, ƙasa da layukan daƙiƙa 15 na Higgsfield](/media/maboroshi/how/cost-per-second.jpg)

Gargaɗi biyu na gaskiya. Idan bidiyo na 480p kawai kake buƙata kuma kana biyan shirin Higgsfield tuni, $2.00 nasa ya fi arha. Mun yi bayani dalla-dalla a [jagorarmu ta madadin Higgsfield Genjutsu](/guides/higgsfield-genjutsu-alternative).

## Gyara shi, wallafa shi, sami kuɗi da shi

Higgsfield yana tsayawa a maɓallin saukewa. A DeHub, bidiyon mafari ne, ba ƙarshen aikin ba.

![Gyara, wallafa, sami kuɗi: editan bidiyo da feed na DeHub](/media/maboroshi/how/fig-edit-post-earn.jpg)

**Editan bidiyo na ciki.** [Editan bidiyo](/editor) na DeHub yana aiki a burauzarka da cikin manhajar DeHub. Layin lokaci ne na gaske mai waƙoƙi da yawa, ba kawai sandar yankewa ba. Saka bidiyon Maboroshi kusa da sauran bidiyoyinka, sannan:

- Yanke a canjin fage da bugun kiɗa.
- Ƙara rubutun ƙasa, kuma fassara dukan waƙar rubutun ƙasa zuwa wani harshe.
- Cire bango.
- Ƙirƙiri kiɗan baya ko tasirin sauti.
- Ɗauki allonka ko muryarka kai tsaye zuwa layin lokaci.

Ayyuka suna adanuwa a gajimare tare da tarihin sigogi, kuma za ka iya raba gyara don samun sharhin dubawa masu alamar lokaci.

**Manhajar sada zumunta da ke kewaye da shi.** DeHub [hanyar sadarwar zamantakewa](/guides/what-is-dehub) ce da kuma ɗakin aiki, don haka gyaran da aka gama yana tafiya kai tsaye daga editan zuwa rubutu ko Short. A can, masu kallo za su iya ba ka kyauta, kuma kallonka ana ƙidaya su don [ladan watch-to-earn](/guides/what-is-watch-to-earn). Masu kallo masu wasu harsuna za su iya kunna fassarar murya ta atomatik. DeHub yana ci gaba da ƙara abubuwa ga feed, Shorts, watsa shirye-shirye kai tsaye da wakilan AI da za su iya wallafawa bisa jadawali.

Asusu ɗaya yana rufe dukan zagayen: yi musanyar, yanke ta zuwa gyara, wallafa ta kuma a biya ka.

## Gwada shi

1. Buɗe [dehub.io/creator/maboroshi](/creator/maboroshi) don musanya abu, ko zaɓi Kling O3 Character Swap a [DeHub Creator](/creator) don canza kowane abu a cikin firam.
2. Loda gajeren bidiyo mai sauti da hoton misali ɗaya ko biyu masu haske.
3. Duba abin rufe fuska, amince, sannan ka yi gyaran. Ana nuna farashin a dala kafin ka biya.
4. Buɗe sakamakon a [editan bidiyo](/editor), kammala gyaranka, kuma wallafa shi a feed ɗinka.

## Tambayoyin da ake yawan yi

### Yaya Higgsfield Genjutsu ke aiki?

Higgsfield ba ya wallafa tsarin aikinsa. Ana gina tasiri irin wannan ta hanyar fara auna bidiyon asali: adadin firam, sauti, zurfi, siffar abin da ragar fuska. Sannan samfurin reference-to-video ko video-edit yana sake yin abin kawai, kuma ana mayar da sautin asali a ƙarshe. Maboroshi yana gudanar da ainihin wannan jerin, kuma wannan jagorar tana nuna kowane mataki.

### Waɗanne samfura ne gyaran irin na Genjutsu ke amfani da su?

A Maboroshi: Demucs don sauti, Video Depth Anything don zurfi, SAM 3 Video don abin rufe fuska, MediaPipe Face Landmarker don fuska, da Seedance 2.5 reference-to-video ko Kling O3 video-to-video edit don gyaran hoto.

### Shin Maboroshi ya fi Higgsfield Genjutsu arha?

A 720p da 1080p, eh. Bidiyo na daƙiƙa 15 yana kashe $4.55 a hanyar Kling ta Maboroshi da $3.02 da Kling O3 Character Swap na Creator, idan aka kwatanta da kusan $5.20 da $7.20 a Higgsfield. Babu zaɓin DeHub da ke buƙatar biyan kuɗin wata-wata. Zaɓin 480p na Higgsfield, kusan $2.00, ya fi arha idan kana da shiri tuni.

### Menene Higgsfield Katana, kuma DeHub yana da wani abu makamancinsa?

Katana fasaha ce ta Higgsfield ta hira don sake gina gyaran misali da mutanenka, kayanka ko tufafinka. A DeHub, Remake yana sake gina bidiyoyi masu hotuna da yawa hoto bayan hoto, Kling O3 Character Swap yana canza halaye, kaya ko shimfiɗar wuri, kuma Seedance 2.0 yana canza salon fage gaba ɗaya. Duka ukun ana farashinsu a kowane bidiyo.

### Zan iya canza bango ko abubuwa, ba mutum kawai ba?

Eh. Yi amfani da Kling O3 Character Swap a DeHub Creator don musanya kaya ko shimfiɗar wuri daga hotunan misali, ko Seedance 2.0 don canza salon dukan bidiyon da umarni. Maboroshi da kansa yana riƙe bango daidai yadda aka ɗauka, wanda shine abin da kake so don tsaftataccen musanyar abu.

### Sautin asali yana nan?

Eh. A hanyoyin Maboroshi biyu, ana kwafa cikakken sautin asali zuwa bidiyon da aka gama, ba a taɓa shi ba.

## Ƙananan bayanai

Alƙaluman Genjutsu na Higgsfield sun fito daga shafin Genjutsu nasa kamar yadda aka duba a Satumba 2026. Bayanan Katana sun fito daga labarin Katana na Higgsfield na 12 ga Oktoba, 2026. Higgsfield yana farashi da kiredit kuma yana canza shirinsa sau da yawa, don haka duba farashinsa na yanzu kafin ka kwatanta. Farashin DeHub farashin dillali ne a lokacin rubutu, kuma farashin da ake nunawa kafin kowane mataki shine koyaushe farashin da za ka biya. An yi hoton zurfi a mataki na 3 da samfurin zurfi na firam ɗaya don misali. Maboroshi da kansa yana amfani da Video Depth Anything.
